mentions.name: Ephemeral Markdown Paper (ephe)
mentions.description: This app is an ephemeral markdown paper for taking notes, built as an open-source, free, no-sign-up alternative to bloated to-do and note-taking apps.
mentions.problem: Typical to-do and note-taking apps are bloated.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on an Ephemeral Markdown Paper: https://github.com/unvalley/ephe

If you’re tired of bloated to-do and note-taking apps, give this a try.
It's OSS, free and No sign-up.
